recipes.title: Chicken traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 200C.
Halve the potatoes, cut the onion into wedges, cut the carrots into batons.
Tip everything into a roasting tin, add the oil, salt and pepper, and turn it over with your hands.
Roast 45 minutes. Turn once at the halfway point so the chicken skin colours evenly.

recipes.title: Sausage and mash
steps: Peel the potatoes, cut them to an even size, boil in salted water 20 minutes until a knife slides through.
Grill or fry the sausages 15 minutes, turning them.
Slice the onion thinly and fry it slowly in a little butter until brown.
Drain the potatoes, dry them in the hot pan for a minute, then mash with the butter and milk.
Season the mash. Serve the sausages on top with the onions.

recipes.title: Red lentil curry
steps: Chop the onion and fry it in oil 8 minutes until soft.
Stir in two spoons of curry paste and cook one minute.
Add the lentils, the tin of tomatoes and the coconut milk, plus a tin of water.
Simmer 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the lentils collapse.
Stir the spinach through at the end. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Chickpea and tomato stew
steps: Chop the onion and three cloves of garlic. Fry in the oil 8 minutes.
Add both tins of tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas, add them, cook another 8 minutes.
Season well, stir the spinach through. Serve with bread.

recipes.title: Mushroom pasta
steps: Boil the pasta in well salted water.
Slice the mushrooms thickly. Fry them in a hot dry pan until the water has gone, then add oil and two chopped cloves of garlic.
Pour in the cream and let it bubble for two minutes.
Drain the pasta, keeping a cup of the water. Toss the pasta through the sauce, loosening it with the water.
Grate the cheddar over the top.

recipes.title: Bacon and egg hash
steps: Cut the potatoes into 2cm cubes and boil 8 minutes. Drain and let them steam dry.
Fry the rashers in a wide pan until crisp, then lift them out and chop.
Fry the potatoes and sliced onion in the bacon fat 12 minutes, pressing them down so they crust.
Stir the bacon back in. Make four gaps, crack an egg into each, cover and cook 4 minutes.

recipes.title: Salmon and leek traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Slice the potatoes 5mm thick and par boil 6 minutes.
Wash the leeks well and cut into thick rings.
Spread the potatoes and leeks in a tin, dot with butter, roast 15 minutes.
Sit the salmon on top, squeeze over the lemon, roast a further 12 minutes until the fish flakes.

recipes.title: Beef chilli
steps: Brown the mince hard in a dry pan, in two batches, so it colours instead of steaming.
Add the chopped onion and peppers, cook 8 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, a spoon of chilli powder and a spoon of cumin. Simmer 25 minutes.
Stir in the drained kidney beans, cook 10 minutes more. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Chicken fajitas
steps: Cut the chicken, peppers and onion into strips of the same size.
Toss the chicken with paprika, cumin, salt and the juice of the lemon.
Fry the chicken in a very hot pan 6 minutes, lift it out, fry the vegetables 5 minutes.
Return the chicken, warm the wraps, serve with grated cheddar and yoghurt.

recipes.title: Broccoli and cheddar soup
steps: Soften the chopped onion in butter 6 minutes.
Add the diced potato and 1.2 litres of stock. Simmer 12 minutes.
Add the broccoli, stalk and all, chopped small. Cook 6 minutes, no longer, or the colour goes.
Blend, add the milk, then stir the grated cheddar in off the heat.

recipes.title: Sweet potato and chickpea bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Cut the sweet potato into 3cm chunks, skin on.
Drain the chickpeas and dry them on a cloth so they crisp.
Toss both with the oil, cumin and salt. Roast 35 minutes.
Fold the spinach through the hot tray, crumble the feta over, back in the oven 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetable fried rice
steps: Cook the rice, spread it on a tray and let it cool. Warm rice turns to paste in the pan.
Dice the carrot small and cut the broccoli into small florets. Fry 5 minutes in a hot pan.
Push the vegetables aside, scramble the eggs in the gap, then mix in.
Add the cold rice, fry hard 4 minutes, season with soy sauce and the sliced scallions.

recipes.title: Cheese on toast with tomato
steps: Toast four slices of bread on one side under a hot grill.
Turn them over, cover the untoasted side with thick grated cheddar right to the edges.
Grill 3 minutes until the cheese bubbles and browns in patches.
Slice the tomatoes, salt them, and put them on top.

recipes.title: Garlic prawn pasta
steps: Boil the pasta in well salted water.
Slice four cloves of garlic thinly and warm them in the oil over a low heat until pale gold.
Raise the heat, add the prawns, cook 3 minutes until they turn opaque.
Drain the pasta, toss it through with a squeeze of lemon and some of the pasta water.
